standard_prerequisites.name: The pushforward f_*O_X equals O_S and is preserved by base change once the natural map kappa(s) -> H^0(X_s, O_{X_s}) is an isomorphism for all s
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement to the fibre computation.

standard_prerequisites.name: The global sections of a proper geometrically reduced scheme over a field are a geometric field extension, and geometric connectedness forces the constant functions

core_obligations: Reduce: by the proper-flat h0 lemma it suffices to show kappa(s) = H^0(X_s, O_{X_s}) for all s in S (proof lines 8325-8327).

Fibre computation: the fibres X_s are geometrically connected and geometrically reduced by hypothesis, so by the varieties lemma their global sections equal the ground field kappa(s) (proof lines 8328-8330).
Conclude f_*O_X = O_S with base-change stability (statement).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the fibrewise identification of global sections (proof lines 8325-8327).
Compute H^0 of the fibres via the varieties lemma (proof lines 8328-8330).
